answer: A workable design: meter the marginal energy cost of each new identity against the network's median. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the marble to sunk effort, uses the glacier as an corroborating signal, then requires a whisper before any payout.
